claims.title: Elementary ideal-lattice Fourier-profile sum
claims.status: New complete human proof, independently checked; stronger power not implemented in Lean.
claims: For a totally complex degree-2f field with f complex-place representatives, ideal norm gives product distance sqrt(Na).
After scaling, a polydisc with product P contains at most 64^f*P^2/Theta^(2f) nonzero lattice points and none for P<Theta^f.
Layer-cake at exponent 3 gives 384^f*Theta^(-5f/2).
For real K>=3, the bound is (384*Theta^(-(K-1/2)))^f, Theta>=1.
This implies the archive's sufficient exponent K-5/2.

The x0=0 branch is immediate by induction.
